featured_reviews.review_text:
BFF Cafe on Marve Road, Malad West, is a delightful place that offers a warm and comfortable café experience. From the moment you enter, the café gives off a friendly and relaxed vibe, making it a great spot to unwind after a long day or spend some quality time with close friends. The interiors are simple yet pleasant, creating a cozy atmosphere that feels inviting and peaceful.

The food at BFF Cafe is definitely one of its highlights. The menu is well curated with a good variety of options, and the taste does not disappoint. Every dish is prepared fresh and served with care, reflecting good quality and attention to detail. The portion sizes are satisfying, and the flavors are well balanced, making it a great value for money. The beverages complement the food perfectly and are ideal for casual conversations and relaxed evenings.

Another aspect that stands out is the service. The staff is polite, courteous, and attentive, ensuring that customers feel comfortable throughout their visit. Orders are served on time, and the team is always ready to help with recommendations or special requests. This level of hospitality adds a personal touch that enhances the overall experience.

One important thing to note is that the café has a relatively small seating area. While this adds to its cozy charm, it may not be suitable for large groups, especially during busy hours. However, for solo visits, couples, or small groups, the space works perfectly and feels intimate rather than crowded.

Overall, BFF Cafe is a great choice if you’re looking for good food, pleasant ambiance, and friendly service in Malad West. It’s an ideal spot for casual meetups and relaxed dining, and definitely a place worth visiting again with friends.

We all reached the place and from outside it looked a small cafe, which had small space inside in A/c and with 3-4 tables of outside siting.

The best coffee place - Coffee King

featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked this café via myHQ as a co-working space, expecting a smooth workday, but the entire experience was extremely disappointing due to poor management, unprofessional staff, and multiple issues.

At entry, we were stopped for 15–20 minutes because the building hadn’t received any confirmation email. Later we were told no such email was required. This lack of coordination between the café, myHQ, and building management wasted our time unnecessarily.

The staff member managing the space (Vinaya, middle-aged lady with specs) had little understanding of co-working bookings. From morning, she kept insisting we place orders despite being informed multiple times that we would order later since we had the space booked for the whole day. She kept interrupting us repeatedly, which was very disruptive. She was also frequently on loud phone calls even after being asked to lower the volume.

There was no WiFi when we arrived, which is unacceptable for a co-working booking. It only started working after basic troubleshooting (router restart) guided by my manager, showing lack of basic technical awareness.

During lunch, we planned to eat outside food and order later from the café. While we understood their policy, we suggested compromises (ordering something along with outside food or sitting outside), but everything was refused. We were forced to stand in a parking area under the sun to eat, despite having the café booked. This was highly unreasonable.

The issue was escalated to the manager (Jay) claiming we hadn’t ordered for 5+ hours, and we had to explain everything again, showing poor communication internally.

Food quality was also poor. One dish had a stone in it, and pasta was stale and had to be canceled. Tables were not clean on arrival, reflecting poor hygiene.

The table size was meant for one person but had two chairs. It’s impractical for two people with laptops. Despite using separate tables logically, we were told we were occupying too much space.

There is no private washroom; we were directed to a public staff washroom. Interiors were poorly maintained with broken walls, and mobile network inside was extremely weak, forcing us to step out repeatedly.

Overall, a very frustrating experience. Even a 1-star rating feels generous.

featured_reviews.name: Fork & Frames
featured_reviews.review_text:
Me and my husband recently visited Aromas Cafe and Bistro located inside Inorbit Mall for dinner, and honestly, we had a really good experience overall. The café has a nice vibe, comfortable seating, and a relaxed atmosphere that makes it a good place to sit and enjoy a meal peacefully. It’s also conveniently located on the ground floor near the parking-side entrance of the mall, which makes it easy to access.

We had ordered two burgers along with a lemon iced tea. My husband ordered the Chicken Steak Burger, while I went for the Veggie Burger. The lemon iced tea arrived first, which actually helped because the food took around 20–30 minutes to arrive. However, while ordering itself, the staff had informed us that they prepare the food fresh and that it would take some time, so we were completely okay with waiting. Still, I think it’s something people should keep in mind if they’re in a hurry.

Coming to the food — my husband absolutely loved his burger. He genuinely said it was one of the good burgers he has had in a very long time - which says a lot because he had been searching for a really good burger place since a long time. The quantity was excellent and quite filling too.

My Veggie Burger was surprisingly delicious as well. Vegetarian burgers often tend to be dry or bland, but this one was juicy, flavourful, and really enjoyable. It came with wedges and salad, though I requested fries instead of veggies, which they happily accommodated. Both the fries and wedges were really good. The salt level was slightly low, but honestly, that’s still better than overly salty food, and we simply added extra salt according to our taste.

Overall, we genuinely liked this place. Good food, good vibe, satisfying quantity
Felt it was a bit on the higher side costed us INR 1200-1300, we spent on dinner for two people. Definitely a place we’d visit again. 🍔✨

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: We had dinner on a weekday and the restaurant was practically empty but so was Inorbit Mall at Malad West where this cafe is housed in. I expected that on a light day like this Wednesday, we might experience slower than usual service but I was pleasantly surprised. Service was excellent, the food was yum and we actually had a meal in peace as there was no weekend crowd. The menu offers a good choice for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike so no one will be disappointed. The food is mostly continental with a mix of Mediterranean, Italian, oriental and of course some Indian. They don’t serve alcohol. The  cafe is located on the ground floor of Inorbit Mall at Malad West. We had the creole fried potatoes, Thai green curry and grilled chicken Teriyaki. The creole potatoes is heavenly - you should try it. The portion size is actually decent and if you are not feeling too hungry, you could share it amongst two - at least the grilled teriyaki chicken looked good enough for two. We shared it. The bistro has a nice welcoming feel to it; simple and well lit interiors and nothing loud. Exactly how a cafe should fees like. For 3 of us with one starter, 2 main course dishes and 3 mocktails the bill was a very reasonable INR 2k which is great. Great food, reasonably priced and good service. Need you ask for more?? Will definitely be back to try the rest of their menu. Oh, and I almost forgot to mention - they don’t forcibly bill you a service charge so do tip if you enjoyed their service and good like we did. Cheers….
